# Naaz AI Labs

> Artificial intelligence research and development studio in Bengaluru, India. Builds bespoke AI systems, CRMs, automation, and web platforms for real estate, resorts, travel agencies, CRM-heavy businesses, hospitality, finance, event management, and education — and Lynq, a productised AI-workforce subscription for WhatsApp, web chat, and phone.

Founded by Mohammed Rayhan (Founder & CEO). Studio located in JP Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Support hours Mon–Sat, 10am–7pm IST. Contact: hello@naazailabs.com.

Every bespoke industry build ships in one of three delivery bands — Standard, Intermediate, Premium — each escalating in scope (Standard: a fast, credible web platform; Intermediate: adds CRM, bookings, and automation; Premium: adds AI voice agents, prediction, and document AI).

## Product

- [Lynq](https://www.naazailabs.com/lynq.html): Productised AI workforce on WhatsApp, website chat, and phone — answers from a business's own documents, qualifies leads, books appointments, runs outbound campaigns. Three plans: Receptionist ₹11,999/mo (chat only), Sales Associate ₹29,999/mo (chat + voice, most popular), Sales Manager ₹74,999/mo (all channels, white-label). Prices exclude 18% GST; annual billing saves 15%. Runs on Google Gemini. Data stored in India (DPDP Act compliant). Supports English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, and more, auto-detected mid-conversation.

## Industries served

- [Real Estate](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#real-estate): Listings, CRM, and AI voice agents for property businesses.
- [Resort](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#resort): Booking platforms, guest CRM, and AI concierge for hospitality properties.
- [Travel Agency](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#travel): Package listings, booking engines, and AI trip planning.
- [CRM Systems](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#crm): Bespoke CRM builds with workflow automation and AI assistants.
- [Hospitality](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#hospitality): Front desk, restaurant, and reservation systems on one spine.
- [Finance](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#finance): Loan origination, KYC automation, and document AI for financial services.
- [Event Management](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#events): Registration, vendor coordination, and ticketing systems.
- [Education](https://www.naazailabs.com/solutions.html#education): Admissions CRM, learning management, and AI teaching assistants.

## Company

- [About](https://www.naazailabs.com/about.html): Studio background, vision, mission, and reach.
- [Services & Pricing](https://www.naazailabs.com/services.html): Twenty services in two groups. Build: website development (₹15,000–₹40,000), website admin panels (₹45,000–₹60,000), 3D websites (₹70,000–₹1,00,000), web applications (₹50,000–₹70,000), mobile apps (₹70,000–₹7,00,000), CRM development (₹15,000–₹60,000), WhatsApp chatbots & automation (from ₹15,000), AI voice calling agents, multi-agent AI infrastructure, workflow automation. Connect & Grow: booking & enquiry systems, SEO (₹5,000–₹25,000), generative engine optimization, Google Business Profile (₹2,000–₹3,000), Google Ads and Meta Ads management (custom pricing, ad spend separate), logo & brand identity (₹3,000–₹5,000), custom software, website-to-WhatsApp and API integrations. All prices indicative, INR, scope-based; domain, hosting, paid APIs and ad budgets charged separately.
- [Proof of Work](https://www.naazailabs.com/proof-of-work.html): Live client websites, CRMs, and admin dashboards across travel, hotels & resorts, clinics, events, decoration, real estate, and security — Somu Holidays, Murudeshwara, Sushi Travels, Hotel Casa Paradiso, Coorg Jungle Mist Resort, Crown Celebrity, Zafoor Clinic, Sid Events, Plan My Decor, Sarakki Homes, and others, each linked to its live site.
- [Technology](https://www.naazailabs.com/technology.html): The stack — TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node, Python, FastAPI, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA, CrewAI, Hermes Agents, RVC voice models, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Selenium, Blender, Cloudflare.
- [Process](https://www.naazailabs.com/process.html): Thirteen delivery phases from discovery to ongoing support.
- [Contact](https://www.naazailabs.com/contact.html): Start a project — real scope (tier, timeline, team) within one business day.
- [Careers](https://www.naazailabs.com/careers.html): Open roles in Bengaluru — SDE 1 (Agentic AI), Digital Marketing & Content Executive, Business Development Associate. Freshers welcome.

- [Store builders vs a custom e-commerce website](https://www.naazailabs.com/blog/store-builders-vs-custom-ecommerce-website.html): Online store builders vs a custom-built e-commerce website: where each wins, what each really costs over time, and how to decide for your products.

- [ERP and business management software: do you need one?](https://www.naazailabs.com/blog/erp-business-management-software.html): ERP, CRM and business management software explained — what each does, when off-the-shelf works, when to build custom management software, and what it costs.
- [Applicant tracking systems (ATS): what they do, and build vs buy](https://www.naazailabs.com/blog/applicant-tracking-system-ats.html): What an applicant tracking system (ATS) does, the features that matter for Indian businesses, and when to buy an ATS or build a custom one.

## Guarantees

Live in 7 days from advance payment. No lock-in — monthly plans cancel with 15 days written notice. 100% refund if a system does not go live, in writing on every proposal. Support in 6 Indian languages, auto-detected mid-conversation.
